blurb: This check verifies that every Shared Ethernet Adapter on a VIOS is configured to fail over to its partner VIOS: ha_mode is auto or standby, a control channel (or a CAA cluster) is in place to arbitrate the primary/backup roles, and each side has a priority. Without that, one VIOS is a single point of failure for every client LPAR bridged through its SEA — when it goes down, the network goes down with it.
